projectDesc.p: This transcription was made by the International Greek New Testament Project (IGNTP) in 2019.

editorialDecl.p: The initial transcription file was a plain text file in Unicode. The original transcription guidelines can be found at . This is a commentary manuscript.
The initial transcriptions were reconciled by Amy Myshrall. The plain text file was converted to XML by Hugh Houghton and Catherine Smith using the project's Python conversion scripts.
The XML specifications used are version 1.6 of the IGNTP Guidelines available at

revisionDesc.change: Addition of block markers for missing verses, plus the odd surplus tag, by Hugh Houghton.
